assessments.rationale: This option maximizes durability and reliability under parameter (a) (Page 79, Annex I) and maintains functional performance under parameter (s) (Page 80, Annex I) by resisting mechanical stresses and preventing premature obsolescence (Page 27, (21)). It also minimizes the release of microplastics and nanoplastics (parameter (p), Page 80, Annex I) caused by physical wear, cracking, or degradation during operation.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Conflicts with the Manufacturing and End-of-Life stages, as thick virgin plastics increase the overall material footprint (Page 80, Annex I (o)), product weight (Page 79, Annex I (j)), and are more resource-intensive to produce than recycled or lightweight alternatives.

options_evaluated: Permanent chemical adhesives or ultrasonic welding
assessments.rationale: This option directly supports parameter (b) ease of repair and maintenance (Page 79, Annex I) and aligns with the need for a high repairability score based on ease of disassembly and compatibility with commonly available tools (Page 8, Recital 36). It allows professional repairers (Page 29, (48)) or users to replace defective internal components without damaging the housing, thereby preventing premature obsolescence (Page 27, (21)).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Conflicts with the Manufacturing stage because using threaded fasteners increases the number of components, assembly complexity, and overall production costs (Page 81).

assessments.rationale: A BLDC motor significantly improves energy efficiency (parameter (g), Page 79, Annex I) in line with Union energy efficiency targets (Page 3, Recital 9). It also enhances durability and reliability (parameter (a), Page 79, Annex I) by eliminating brush wear, extending the technical lifetime (Page 27, (22)), and reduces noise emissions (parameter (q), Page 80, Annex I).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Conflicts with the Manufacturing stage due to higher initial component costs (Page 81) and the use of critical raw materials (such as rare-earth magnets in the rotor) (Page 79, Annex I (h)).

options_evaluated: Dedicated active clean-air cooling path with independent fan
assessments.recommendation: Dedicated active clean-air cooling path with independent fan
assessments.rationale: This ensures the motor operates under optimal thermal conditions, protecting it from overheating and thermal stress, which supports durability and reliability (parameter (a), Page 79, Annex I) and prevents premature obsolescence (Page 27, (21)). It maintains high functional performance (parameter (s), Page 80, Annex I) even when the main suction path is temporarily blocked or restricted.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Conflicts with the Design and Manufacturing stages by increasing the product's spatial volume, weight (Page 79, Annex I (j)), and complexity of internal ducting and assembly.

options_evaluated: Modular architecture with easily swappable functional blocks (motor, cord reel, filtration)
assessments.recommendation: Modular architecture with easily swappable functional blocks (motor, cord reel, filtration)
assessments.rationale: This architecture directly serves parameter (b) ease of repair and maintenance (Page 79, Annex I) and parameter (l) availability and accessibility of spare parts (Page 79, Annex I). It allows targeted replacement of only the failed module, significantly reducing the amount of waste generated during the service life (parameter (r), Page 80, Annex I) and maximizing the product's technical lifetime (Page 27, (22)).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Conflicts with the Manufacturing and Design stages because modular interfaces require extra structural connectors, which increases the product's weight, volume (Page 79, Annex I (j)), and material footprint (Page 80, Annex I (o)).

options_evaluated: Mains-powered (corded) with a robust, replaceable cord reel
Cordless with user-replaceable modular battery pack
assessments.recommendation: Mains-powered (corded) with a robust, replaceable cord reel
assessments.rationale: Mains power ensures consistent, unlimited functional performance (parameter (s), Page 80, Annex I) and avoids the durability and reliability issues associated with battery degradation (parameter (a), Page 79, Annex I), preventing premature obsolescence (Page 27, (21)). It also completely eliminates the generation of hazardous battery waste during the in-service phase (parameter (r), Page 80, Annex I).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Conflicts with User Experience/Design stages due to reduced portability and convenience, and with Manufacturing due to the physical space, weight (Page 79, Annex I (j)), and cost of the cord reel mechanism.
